# Customer profile

Tidewater Dispatch sells to regional moving companies that run their own crews and trucks. The person who buys is the owner or the operations manager, who plans each day's jobs on a whiteboard or a spreadsheet today.

We do not sell to national van lines, to freight brokers, or to storage businesses.
